initial_findings: The source-regex-only test could not falsify flake selection, argument forwarding, or recursion.
Any ancestor containing fabrics/data/flake.nix could be mistaken for an Engine workspace.
Final evidence.bundle.json and durable runtime evidence were not yet present.
fixes: The exact shared shell logic is now executed against marked Engine, unrelated-flake, fallback, argv, and recursion fixtures.
Engine selection now requires root Cargo.toml, fabrics/data/Cargo.toml, fabrics/data/flake.nix, and fabrics/data/nix/flake/packages.nix.
The Home Manager module delegates directly to the tested shared logic.

publication_review.finding: The verification plan named purpose-validate-work directly even though the dotfiles shell did not expose that bare command.
publication_review.resolution: The work specification and README now declare the exact runnable pinned local Nix app invocation with --require-evidence.
publication_review.closure: The reviewer independently ran the declared command, observed ok=true and authorizes_execution=true, and reported no remaining Critical or Important issue.
